title: A2.2 — Future, Conditional, & Object Pronouns
description: Talk about future plans, make predictions and requests, express what you would do in hypothetical situations, and use object pronouns to avoid repetition.

themes.title: Simple Future — Regular Conjugation
themes.description: Add future endings to the full infinitive to express actions that will happen.

themes.title: Future — Irregular Stems
themes.description: Learn the irregular future stems: tendr-, dir-, pondr-, podr-, querr-, har-, sabr-, vendr-, saldr-.

themes.title: Conditional — Regular Conjugation
themes.description: Express hypothetical situations and polite requests using the conditional tense.

themes.title: Conditional — Irregular Stems
themes.description: Learn conditional irregulars using the same stems as the future (tendr-, dir-, pondr-, etc.).

themes.title: Past Perfect (Pluscuamperfecto)
themes.description: Describe actions that happened before another past action using había + past participle.

themes.title: Object Pronoun Combinations
themes.description: Combine direct and indirect object pronouns into single words (se lo, te lo, me la).

themes.title: Verbs + Prepositions
themes.description: Master fixed verb+preposition combinations: pensar en, salir con, depender de, soñar con.
